source.extraction: Table 11 from the PDF text layer; Table 14 is an image and was read from the rendered page (page 32, 130 dpi) and checked visually. AI-assisted; independent review pending.

CPA_402_11.design: Single 20 mg oral dose, fasted, healthy volunteers, two-period crossover; test = half a Neofordex 40 mg tablet, reference = 44 x Dectancyl 0.5 mg; sampling to 36 h; WinNonlin NCA.

MM_017.location: section 2.4.2, 'Pharmacokinetics in target population', Table 14, page 32 (image)
MM_017.design: CC-5013-MM-017-PK: 6 Japanese patients with previously treated multiple myeloma; dexamethasone 40 mg (as 4 mg tablets) once daily on Days 2-4 and 9-12, lenalidomide 25 mg on Days 1 and 3-12; serial sampling after an overnight fast on Day 2 (dexamethasone alone, first dose) and Day 12.

spoorenberg_2014_context.citation: Spoorenberg SMC, et al. Pharmacokinetics of oral vs. intravenous dexamethasone in patients hospitalized with community-acquired pneumonia. Br J Clin Pharmacol. 2014;78(1):78-83. doi:10.1111/bcp.12295
